hints.title: Staged Discovery
hints.text: Every element needs its second greater value to the right. Decompose the search into finding the first greater element, followed by the second.

hints.title: Two-Tier Staging
hints.text: Maintain one sequence of indices looking for their first greater element, and a second sequence of indices that have already found their first and are waiting for their second.

hints.title: Transitioning Between States
hints.text: When a new element exceeds values in the second sequence, their answers are determined. When it exceeds values in the first sequence, transfer them to the second sequence.

hints.title: Two-Stage Monotonic Buffer Implementation

complexity.notes: Each index is pushed and popped from s1 and s2 at most twice, amortizing to linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning forwards for both greater elements for each index takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space to maintain intermediate index buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extends monotonic next-greater indexing to two successive phases using staged buffers.
